description: next/ v4 - product/material master. Attributes aligned to the LIVE projection of source sim-v5-erp-articles. ISA-95 MaterialDefinition (the definition; physical stock is MaterialLot). --- 2026-08-30 CAPT-ITLANE, 2.1.0: NO LONGER a pure reference entity. It carries the plant's stock position (stock_free / stock_reserved / stock_blocked / stock_available) and its planning thresholds (reorder_level / safety_stock), and with them the single-entity rule stock_below_reorder_level. WHY IT MOVED HERE: the identical statement used to live on profiles/wms/quant.json as a literal band [20,500] over ONE PALLET's quantity, and it could neither be true nor fire. Not true, because a Quant is one lot in one bin - median quantity 1 over a 5000-row window of the live WMS, 4745 of 5000 outside [20,500] - so the band judged 95 % of the population as deviating and meant nothing by it. Not able to fire, because quant_id carries a mint timestamp (Q-<machine>-<YYYYMMDDhhmmss>-<article>), so every production event is a NEW entity, each entity is evaluated exactly once, and the anti-chatter run rule 'k=2 of 3' is arithmetically unreachable on a population that is never observed twice. An article is the opposite on every axis that matters: 221 rows, populationComplete=true on every 30 s poll, and 5.5 of them change per minute - a BOUNDED key space with real re-observation, which is the only kind of subject over which 'persistently outside the band' is a sentence at all. The threshold is not invented either: it is the article's own mindestbestand, and it reaches the wire as a FIELD (constraint_observed.reorder_level, beside constraint_observed.stock_available), never as prose. MEASURED YIELD 2026-08-30: 12 of 221 articles (5.4 %) below their reorder level - against 4745 of 5000 for the rule it replaces. impact_basis is deliberately ABSENT: the affected quantity of a below-reorder finding is a planning shortfall, not a scrapped or unsold lot, so there is no honest euro model to declare, and the episode ranks in the proxy tier rather than carrying a fabricated figure into a euro headline.

attributes.name: cost_hk
attributes.description: Standard manufacturing/purchase cost (HK = Herstellkosten), from ERP std_kosten. The €-basis for scrap / quality impact.

attributes.name: price_vk
attributes.description: Standard sales price (VK = Verkaufspreis), from ERP std_verkaufspreis. The basis for margin / lost-sales impact. Null for non-sellable articles (RAW/CONSUMABLE/WIP).

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: ISO-4217 currency code for cost_hk / price_vk, from ERP waehrung (e.g. EUR).

attributes.name: stock_free
attributes.description: Free (unblocked) stock of this article across all warehouses (menge_frei). Served by GET /api/articles, which is ARTICLE_WITH_STOCK_AND_PRICE_SQL. This is the article-level figure the WMS Quant rows sum to; a single Quant is one pallet/lot in one bin and is NOT a stock position.

attributes.name: stock_reserved
attributes.description: Quantity already committed to orders (menge_reserviert) — free stock that is spoken for.

attributes.name: stock_available
attributes.description: AVAILABLE-TO-PROMISE: free minus reserved (verfuegbar). THE operand of stock_below_reorder_level. Deliberately not stock_free: a pallet that is physically present but already committed cannot cover the next demand, and cross-constraints/material_unavailable#successor names exactly this ('a stock operand that is a real reservation/ATP figure, not a raw quant snapshot') as its precondition. MEASURED .154:38260 2026-08-30: present on 218 of 221 rows; the 3 nulls make the rule read 'unknown', never 'ok'.

attributes.name: reorder_level
attributes.description: Reorder level / Meldebestand from the ERP article master (mindestbestand). THE THRESHOLD OF stock_below_reorder_level, and it is PER ARTICLE: measured 2026-08-30 it takes 43 distinct values from 8 to 5000 (WIP 8/10/20, RAW 20..700, FINISHED 0..5000, CONSUMABLE 80..5000). That range is the evidence that the retired literal band [20,500] on Quant.quantity was a single WIP-shaped number applied to every material in the plant.

attributes.name: safety_stock
attributes.description: Safety stock (safety_stock). Carried for completeness and NOT used by a rule: measured 2026-08-30 the smallest margin (stock_available - safety_stock) across the 182 articles with a positive safety stock is 230, and all 12 articles currently below their reorder level have safety_stock = 0, so a 'below safety stock' rule could not fire against this population. Declaring it anyway would add a second error-severity alarm with the wire cut - the defect that retired qty_shortfall and material_unavailable. The number is recorded here instead of being asserted by a dormant guard.

constraints.name: stock_below_reorder_level
constraints.description: Stock below the reorder level: the article's available-to-promise stock (free minus reserved) has fallen under the reorder level the ERP article master declares FOR THIS ARTICLE. The IT/planning counterpart to the OT machine bands - a materials-planning finding about an article, not about a machine.

isa95.note: Article / part = ISA-95 MaterialDefinition (Part 2). Physical stock is MaterialLot.
